description: Read current catalog policy or source registration using required kind=policy|source and stable_id. Ordinary reads require no Operator role and change no state. current includes the complete typed configuration and provenance, including active or retired lifecycle_state; absent current is null with an advisory warning and no replacement numeric defaults. Optional numerical settings that were never set or were cleared remain null. Supply history_limit as an explicit positive integer to request immutable history ordered by revision and row id. Omit history_limit for current only: history and next_after are null, rather than an implicitly truncated history. To continue a history page, pass its exact next_after [revision, id] as after together with history_limit; next_after=null ends pagination. History snapshots retain actor, reason, action, recorded_at, expected_revision and predecessor_revision_id through correction, clear, retirement and reopening. Source readback exposes credential_ref only, never credential values or a credential-service lookup. Policy/source configuration and registration enabled state are separate from model cell enablement. For writes use set_model_catalog_policy or set_model_catalog_source as the current Operator with stable_id, action=set|correct|clear|retire|reopen, nonblank reason and expected_revision from readback; initial set explicitly expects an absent revision with null. Those writers accept values only for set/correct and clear_fields only for clearing optional fields, derive identity server-side and accept no actor parameter.
embedding_description: Read versioned catalog policy or source registrations, including current state and explicitly paginated immutable history. Inspect revision premises, correction and retirement provenance, null absent settings and credential references before a separate Operator-authorized configuration change.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: current complete snapshot or null; history page or null when not requested; next_after continuation frontier or null; warnings for absent configuration.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Show stable identity, current revision and lifecycle state; retain immutable history and predecessor provenance. Present missing optional settings as null and preserve warnings without inventing numeric defaults. Source credentials appear only as references.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Use next_after as after with history_limit to continue. For an explicit Operator mutation, use the current revision as expected_revision, or explicit null only for initial set when current is absent.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Typed catalog policy/source configuration through StateManagementInterface; no network fetch, live schema application, credential resolution, deployment or session lifecycle action.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: parameter_invalid: supply kind=policy|source, nonblank stable_id, positive integer history_limit and the exact next_after [revision, id] as after; after requires history_limit. state_service_unavailable: restore the state-service binding; absence is otherwise returned as current=null with an advisory. For subsequent mutation, parameter_invalid: correct the action, declared field types, nonblank stable_id/reason, explicit expected_revision, values or clear_fields; use clear to remove optional values. stale_catalog_revision: read the current record and decide again with its revision; initial set requires an absent record and expected_revision=null, and no stale write partially commits. invalid_transition: retire only an active record or reopen only a retired record; read its current lifecycle_state first. operator_required: invoke from the currently bound Operator session. operator_identity_spoofed: remove supplied actor, agent_session_id and agent_instance_id; identity is server-derived, never a parameter. state_service_unavailable: restore the state-service binding and retry the explicit request after checking current state.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: parameter_invalid: supply kind=policy|source, nonblank stable_id, positive integer history_limit and the exact next_after [revision, id] as after; after requires history_limit. state_service_unavailable: restore the state-service binding; absence is otherwise returned as current=null with an advisory. For subsequent mutation, parameter_invalid: correct the action, declared field types, nonblank stable_id/reason, explicit expected_revision, values or clear_fields; use clear to remove optional values. stale_catalog_revision: read the current record and decide again with its revision; initial set requires an absent record and expected_revision=null, and no stale write partially commits. invalid_transition: retire only an active record or reopen only a retired record; read its current lifecycle_state first. operator_required: invoke from the currently bound Operator session. operator_identity_spoofed: remove supplied actor, agent_session_id and agent_instance_id; identity is server-derived, never a parameter. state_service_unavailable: restore the state-service binding and retry the explicit request after checking current state.
